summary: Validated L1 execution benchmark reconciled to revision 5: a causal queue-aware maker/taker gate reduced five-second execution drag by 0.200 bp in development, 0.199 bp in validation and 0.149 bp in confirmation, but standalone net expectancy remained about -11.8 bp. Retain as the execution-routing component leader for prospective Shadow only; the strategy Champion is unchanged.

Four-asset leave-one-out common-factor residual study. The strongest hard-valid exploratory state-exit candidate 021fbab613517a31ad98 produced 194 one-global-slot trades in 2023. After exact official funding cashflows it returned +23.2585%, +16.7170% and +11.2649% at 12/18/24 bps; 12-bps geometric daily growth was 0.0573077%, PF 1.504 and MDD 4.617%. It is closer to the 1% target than the prior first place and is ranking-eligible, but the registered economic gate failed: removing the largest 10% trades changes return to -21.8583%, median trade is negative, and all four frozen 2024 family portfolios lost. No later holdout or order permission was opened.

Official/hard-pinned BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT one-minute state with historical funding and one global account slot. The preregistered 216-policy five-minute screen and 324-policy prior-volume dollar-clock follow-up produced zero development survivors and opened no sequential OOS. Exploratory aligned-continuation 33034b092ffd271a recorded 0.0227977% geometric daily growth at approximately 15bp round trip and 0.0118956% at approximately 30bp, with 184/183 trades, but failed the yearly robustness gate and 2x top-five-removal test. It ranks second under the revision-8 objective-proximity table and grants no paper or live permission.
